How to Play Goldfish Scooping{KP}Move the net with the directional buttons and dip it with the Circle button!{KP}Hold the Circle button down, then let go quickly to scoop up goldfish!{KP}Big goldfish and black pop-eyes are worth lots of points!{KP}But! Watch out for this one thing!{KP}Don't mistake the dirty-colored Pauperfish for a goldfish!{KP}Scoop up a Pauperfish by accident and you'll lose 500 points!{KP}Scoop lots at once for bonus points!{KP}Press the X button while moving the net to speed up!{KP}Try your best to scoop up every last goldfish!{KP}When the time hits 0 or your net tears, it's game over!
